visible_text: Q4移行計画の打ち合わせ

observation.happening: Home dashboard showing upcoming schedule, recent meetings, and recording feature. Japanese interface for what appears to be a meeting/productivity tool.
observation.most_important: Clean separation between upcoming schedule (calendar events) and recent meetings. Recording feature is prominently featured as a primary action.
observation.next_action: User can either start recording, view upcoming meetings, or view recent meeting details.
anomalies: Footer shows 'ui-check' — suggests this may be a design audit tool itself rather than finished product

ai_look: Generic card-based layout is somewhat templated
4143.why: Well-organized dashboard with clear sections and good information architecture. The recording feature is notable. However, the card-based layout feels somewhat generic and the design doesn't stand out as particularly innovative when compared to existing productivity tools.

observation.happening: Small dark toast/loading indicator with 'Preparing...' text and ESC key hint.
observation.most_important: Indicates loading or preparation state. ESC hint suggests this is dismissible.
observation.next_action: Wait for preparation to complete, or press ESC to dismiss.

429E.why: Too minimal to evaluate design system comprehensively. Only visible are a loading state indicator and keyboard hint. Single state element cannot convey full design quality.

observation.happening: Google Meet meeting recording/transcript view showing real-time transcription with speaker identification. Meeting is 5+ minutes in. Dark theme applied.
observation.most_important: Transcript is organized by speaker with timestamp markers. Tabs allow switching between original, translation, and live views. Captions and notes features are accessible.
observation.next_action: Participants continue meeting or review transcript details. Can generate notes or ask questions via Ask Astra.
anomalies: Transcript density is high — all entries appear at similar text sizes without clear visual distinction between speakers

ai_look: Tabbed interface is standard Google pattern
458E.why: Functional meeting transcription UI with clear tabs and speaker labeling. Dark theme is professional. However, the dense text and lack of visual distinction between different dialogue entries makes it feel utilitarian rather than polished. This is expected Google design execution, not exceptional.

observation.happening: Dark loading/thinking indicator showing 'Thinking...' in Japanese. Appears to be AI processing state.
observation.most_important: Indicates active processing. No other controls visible.

492F.why: Minimal loading state indicator. Too small and single-purpose to evaluate overall design system. Cannot judge typography, geometry, craft from this fragment alone.

observation.happening: Notion modal panel showing AI-suggested actions for a page ('Q3 Product Roadmap'). Dark theme with four clickable suggestion items.
observation.most_important: AI suggestions are presented as a curated list with clear action labels. Each item appears to be a distinct capability (summarize, extract todos, find decisions, ask questions).
observation.next_action: User selects one of the four suggested actions to process the page.

ai_look: The 'SUGGESTED' label and action-list format are clearly AI-driven recommendations, but integration is seamless and non-generic
4C8F.why: Exceptionally clean and well-executed modal. Perfect alignment and spacing, clear visual hierarchy, minimal design, and no obvious flaws. The Notion branding is consistent and the suggestion format is intuitive. This is polished, professional, and would stand alongside top-tier desktop products.

visible_text: マイクと 画面の音を聞いています
AI が見ている資料 4件

observation.happening: Google Meet recording in progress (05:23 elapsed) with AI-generated meeting notes categorized into four sections: decisions, action items, questions, and concerns. Right sidebar shows transcript preview. Bottom shows sharing/export options.
observation.most_important: Meeting notes are automatically categorized by AI, making key information immediately scannable. Multiple export targets available (Notion, Gmail). Transcript is visible on right for reference.
observation.next_action: Continue meeting or export/share the organized notes to external tools.
anomalies: Interface combines recording controls, notes, and transcript in one view — multiple competing focal points
Spacing between sections varies, creating visual rhythm that feels less intentional

ai_look: Notion/Gmail sharing options are predictable pattern
Overall layout prioritizes information density over visual calm
515D.why: Good functionality and useful categorization, but the interface feels information-dense and somewhat utilitarian. The combination of recording controls, multiple note sections, and transcript preview creates visual complexity. Design execution is professional but expected — it solves the problem without standout craft.
